price_diff.example_label: Example monthly cost for 10M input tokens and 2M output tokens. Labeled example, not a bill.

api_changes.detail: The Groq API reference says speech is POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/speech. The printed sample uses model playai-tts and voice Fritz-PlayAI. Voice is required. This sample keeps that voice value and only changes the model field. The reference does not say the replacement accepts Fritz-PlayAI.

code_change.before:
from groq import Groq
client = Groq()
speech = client.audio.speech.create(
    model="playai-tts",
    voice="Fritz-PlayAI",
    input="Hello",
    response_format="wav",
)
code_change.after:
from groq import Groq
client = Groq()
speech = client.audio.speech.create(
    model="canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english",
    voice="Fritz-PlayAI",
    input="Hello",
    response_format="wav",
)
